summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GrimAIO Roblox script key website. Backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly with successful Stripe integration.

flaky_endpoints.symptoms: Returns 500 error due to Stripe API connectivity issues
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Checkout creation works fine, only status checking fails

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about missing Description for DialogContent

passed_tests: Homepage loads with GrimAIO branding and dark theme
Product selection cards display correct pricing (Monthly €9.27, Lifetime €17.38)
Product selection functionality with visual feedback
Add to Cart functionality with cart badge
Cart sheet opens and displays items correctly
Discord join button links to correct URL (https://discord.gg/t2VrGXbTV)
Backend API /api/checkout creates Stripe checkout session
Checkout button redirects to Stripe successfully
Stripe payment form loads with correct amount
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix checkout status endpoint (/api/checkout/status/{session_id}) - investigate Stripe API connectivity issue causing 500 errors. Add aria-describedby to shadcn Dialog components to resolve console warnings.
